description.ko: 하나의 컴파일러 바이너리로 통합 검사가 끝난 시점을 보존한다. 이후 작업 트리 변경의 검증을 뜻하지 않는다.
description.en: Preserve one coherent compiler/test checkpoint without certifying later working-tree changes.

binary.execution_scope: Local host execution; not proof of every target platform.

source_snapshot.working_tree: Includes uncommitted development changes. Git HEAD alone is not the tested source snapshot.
source_snapshot.identity_boundary: The inventory content hash identifies the recorded declaration snapshot. The binary hash and test log hash identify tested artifacts; later source edits are excluded.

ctest.note: Build logs are local, ignored evidence artifacts and may be replaced by later runs. The recorded hashes and counts remain the checkpoint identity.

cancellation.scope: Only sealed CancellationSource/Token and five Task cancellation aliases. Clone/derivation are explicitly fallible; no worker Task<T>, source TaskScope or spawn.

thread_safety.scope: Independent analysis foundation only; does not enable worker Task/Scope source APIs.

selected_gates.map_entry: The complete registered accepted/negative/allocation-recovery gate is included in this coherent pass. The earlier b18f9833 scoped pass took19.62seconds.
selected_gates.ordered: The complete registered ordered source gate passed on this exact binary; complete catalog iterator contracts remain separate.

browser_check.source: Reported by the coordinating agent after browser inspection.
browser_check.cleanup: English restored; browser tab and temporary local server closed.

excluded_future_work: Task worker/Scope source implementation started after this checkpoint; its declarations and behavior are unvalidated until a new coherent gate.
The latest BorrowChecker Task integration changes are not compiled into the recorded binary.
The full CPU catalog remains incomplete; declaration counts and passing existing tests are not full contract coverage.
GPU-only operations and Pending remain deferred.
Performance-changing optimization remains on hold pending the absent final Claude advice.
